subQuests.subQuestName: Go register at the border checkpoint with Thoma

20120101.text: Hello, please state your name, identity, and the purpose of your visit. Oh, except you, Thoma.

20120104.text: Excuse me? Please provide the information requested, and also declare any goods you are carrying with you.

20120106.text: Currently, only members of the International Trade Association are authorized to engage in the import and export of goods. Do you have your trader's permits?

20120110.text: My apologies, but I'll have to ask you to—

20120111.text: Here are their entry papers, for your kind perusal.

20120112.text: What!? Ugh, take your time! No rush or anything!

20120113.text: Haha, I just wanted to see what you'd say... sorry about that.

20120114.text: ...I see, okay. Your papers are all in order. Welcome to Ritou.

20120116.text: So, where do we go next?

20120118.text: They only check entry permits here. If you want to remain on Ritou, there's a process you have to go through with them.

20120119.text: Sheesh, so it is super strict, just like everyone says.

20120120.text: Well, let's not forget that to everyday folk in Inazuma, people from everywhere else are referred to as "outsiders."

20120121.text: As the word suggests, outlanders aren't very welcome in Inazuma with the Sakoku Decree in force.

20120122.text: Not even on Ritou, where they've established an Outsider Settlement.

20120108.text: Oh? Well, I'm sorry. We cannot approve entry for purely personal reasons. So, unless you have a valid reason for visiting in accordance with the rules...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go process your application at the Outlander Affairs Agency with Thoma

20120201.text: You've completed the entry procedures, yes? And now you want to apply for residency? Both of you?

20120203.text: Okay. The processing fee will be two million Mora.

20120204.text: T—Two million! For a processing fee? Are you serious!?

20120205.text: That's right, one million per applicant, which makes two million total. Don't worry, you can trust my math.

20120206.text: Paimon wasn't so much questioning your math as... Ugh...

20120207.text: Hahaha... Ma'am, these two here are good friends of mine. I think you'll find I'm one face you recognize.

20120208.text: Ah, Mr. Thoma, it's you. By way of courtesy, allow me to reduce it to 400,000 Mora total.

20120211.text: Thank you ever so much, Miss Yurika.

20120212.text: But as this is just a processing fee... I think 600 Mora should cover it if I'm paying on their behalf? I'll treat you to dinner, too. How does that sound?

20120213.text: That's not how you haggle! By all means, bargain the price down, but—

20120214.text: Alright then. As you wish, Mr. Thoma. I will make a record.

20120217.text: What!? She went from two million down to 600? There's something seriously wrong with people's sense of finance around here!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the International Trade Association and understand its members' situation

20120301.text: Oh? Hello there, you must be seeking refuge with the International Trade Association. The Outlander Affairs Agency took you for all you're worth, I suppose.

20120304.text: Ah, good, that's a relief. *sigh* ...You need to be careful, or you'll find yourself losing your savings all at once.

20120305.text: We heard the association has been having some difficulties lately. Is that true?

20120306.text: Yes... left, right, and center. Obstacles at every turn. But that's nothing new for us.

20120307.text: The Sakoku Decree certainly makes things difficult for anyone who wants to come here from overseas.

20120308.text: But it's not the root cause of our woes. The Sakoku Decree might restrict our scope of activity, but in and of itself it doesn't stop us from being able to enjoy a comfortable existence.

20120309.text: No, what's really squeezing us outlander merchants dry is...

20120311.text: Oh, of the three Commissions, that's the one that oversees everything on Ritou, isn't it?

20120312.text: That's right. They impose astronomical tax rates, unbelievable regulations, and that's not the worst of it...

20120313.text: They just issued a new Tax Decree recently that, for some reason, completely changes the way we pay our taxes. It used to be Mora, but now it's something called Crystal Marrow.

20120315.text: Something that most of us in the association had never heard of before either, until the new decree came along.

20120316.text: Eventually, one of the older Liyue merchants recalled that he once shipped a batch of it to Snezhnaya in his youth.

20120317.text: So in order to pay our taxes, we began an arduous search for this Crystal Marrow.

20120318.text: But then we found we'd only managed to create a bigger problem for ourselves. The rising demand for Crystal Marrow drove the price higher and higher...

20120319.text: Now, there's only one vendor who even has it in stock. We can't get hold of it anywhere else...

20120320.text: Uh... isn't that what they call a monopoly?

20120321.text: Exactly. So this vendor keeps pushing the price up, and we have no choice but to buy from them because the Tax Decree forces us to...

20120322.text: It's a vicious cycle, the consequence of which is that our taxes will soon exceed our profits... and once that happens...

subQuests.subQuestName: Find the merchant selling Crystal Marrow

20120401.text: Hm? I don't think I recognize you, are you new arrivals?

20120404.text: Haha, very funny. Real "Fixers" don't need to refer to themselves that way. I wasn't born yesterday, you know.

20120405.text: So. What do you need with me?

20120406.text: Where do you source your goods?

20120407.text: The sheer nerve! You don't go around asking questions like that! If I gave you my sources, I might as well hand you the whole darn business!

20120408.text: Trade secret, got it? You know what "trade" and "secret" mean, right? Tsk.

20120409.text: This guy's got a bad attitude...

20120411.text: Hah! Are you even buying!? ...Ohh, I see what's going on here. Kurisu and his associates sent you here to try and plead their case, didn't they?

20120412.text: Heh, they're wasting their time. The price is non-negotiable, not by a single Mora.

20120414.text: Get out of here, go on. Tell them they're lucky to be buying from me in the first place, and they ought to be more grateful. If it weren't for me, they'd be in seriously hot water.

20120415.text: What are we gonna do? There's no talking to this guy...

20120501.text: Hm? That was quick... You resolved it already?

20120502.text: Um, actually we're having a little trouble...

20120523.text: You're going to have to help us help you.

20120503.text: Oh? Well, by all means, tell me what you need. I'll help as much as I can.

20120504.text: Getting you to go fixing things when you've only just arrived is quite a demand.

20120505.text: What do you know about Werner?

20120507.text: He used to be a bit of a sorry sight, selling shells that he'd collect on the beach just to get by. But he seems to have suddenly shot up in the world recently.

20120508.text: I can only assume he must have found himself a patron after leaving the International Trade Association.

20120509.text: Huh? You're saying he used to be a member of the International Trade Association? So he's an outlander, too?

20120510.text: Yes... couldn't you tell when you spoke to him?

20120513.text: That's right, Werner was born in Mondstadt, then went into the shipping business, trading between Liyue and Inazuma.

20120514.text: When Inazuma closed to the outside world, he was one of a group of outlanders that ended up stranded on Ritou.

20120516.text: The International Trade Association was initially very generous to him, but over time, with decree after decree, the association members found it increasingly difficult to make ends meet...

20120517.text: So, he left the association and turned his back on them!

20120518.text: Haha, I'm sure it's more nuanced than that. I believe even the most ungrateful and cold-hearted of people still have some amount of gratitude and warmth left in them somewhere.

20120601.text: What are you doing back here? Just 'cause I got plenty of time on my hands doesn't mean I want to waste any of it talking to you.

subQuests.subQuestName: Show Werner the goods from Mondstadt

20120609.text: Goodness, I can sense it now. So familiar, but I can't remember the last time I was there...

20120610.text: Ah, the scent of Mondstadt... Oh, how it takes me back...

20120613.text: *sigh* My hometown... The home of freedom...! How I long to go back and visit...

20120615.text: Ah... Oh — ahem! So, trying to play my heartstrings like a lyre are you? I know what you're up to.

20120617.text: Huh? What is this, what are you up to now?

20120619.text: Listen closely... doesn't it sound familiar...?

20120620.text: You mean... the sound of the ocean?

subQuests.subQuestName: Show Werner the goods from Liyue

20120629.text: Wait... Stop, that's enough... Don't make me relive it any more, my poor heart can't take it...

20120632.text: You mean... the folks from the International Trade Association... And I suppose they are far from home, just like me.

20120633.text: Often, I'll sneak down to the shore at night and listen to the sound of the waves... I like to imagine it's the voice of my hometown, carried across the ocean.

20120634.text: I've run into folks from the association more than a few times doing just that, but I always hide my face and slip away...

20120635.text: *sigh* Don't you think I've wanted to talk things through with them, and free myself from this anguish?

20120636.text: Um... well, no one's stopping you, so...

20120637.text: They're so resilient. None of them had anyone else to rely on, so they rallied together, committed to finding a way to survive... But I couldn't do it, I'm not strong enough...

20120638.text: So... I caved... Those people, they'd make the smallest of promises, offer the most measly benefits, and I'd do whatever they asked of me... and make Mondstadters look like the worst people in the world...

20120640.text: ...Alright, I'll tell you the whole story. It's eating me up inside and I can't take it anymore.

20121301.text: What could he be doing at a place like this...

20121302.text: It looked like he buried something over there, didn't it? Why don't we take a look?

20121402.text: Boring... Paimon thought he'd hidden a big pile of Mora here.

20121406.text: Let me take a look here...

20121407.text: Aha, yes. This is what we're looking for. A clear and complete record of every single transaction, each one proof of his guilt.

20121408.text: Great! Well, now we have our hard evidence, let's go tell Kurisu the good news, shall we?

20121409.text: Ah, um... I—I'll say goodbye to you here, then.

20121410.text: Huh? You aren't gonna come with us?

20121411.text: I... I need a little more time before I'm ready to face the head of the association. I'm sorry.

20121412.text: *sigh* Poor Werner's a pretty awkward guy, huh...

subQuests.subQuestName: Tell the International Trade Association about what really happened

20120901.text: But we really don't have anything left. If this keeps up, our sales will come in at a loss. There'll be nothing left for us to do but starve...

20120902.text: You know the decree. The rules are the rules. No discounts, no exceptions — and no excuses!

20120903.text: You're the one making a mockery of the rules here, Keijirou!

20120904.text: Hmm? And who are you? Another new member of the association?

20120905.text: It just so happens that we found your little ledger. So now we're here to tell everyone all about how you embezzled Crystal Marrow to sell it right back to the tax payers!

20120908.text: Well, uh... You see... The t—taxes, uh...

20120909.text: Let me take a look at the ledger.

20120910.text: Text on a black screen: Kurisu reads aloud every entered transaction in full.

20120911.text: Well would you look at that... Every payment the association has made is right here in your personal ledger.

20120912.text: So, Mr. Keijirou, it seems you have some explaining to do. How shall we settle this, hmm?

20120913.text: Hmph! So you think you can use this against me do you? I—It's quite obvious that I'm merely trying to earn a modest living for myself, like anyone else...!

20120914.text: Word has it that samurai in the commission place great importance on reputation and prestige... Though, I'm sure commission members won't blame you once word gets out...

20120915.text: Huh? Is that a threat? Are you threatening me!?

20120916.text: No, not at all. I'm simply stating that it would be quite a pity if an illustrious gentleman such as yourself were to have their reputation tarnished.

20120917.text: Uhh... W—Well even if what you say is true, what do you suggest we do about it...?

20120918.text: I believe you still have a quantity of Crystal Marrow in your possession, correct?

20120919.text: Perhaps that Crystal Marrow could be used as compensation for the recent tax hike, and us merchants could finally have some more breathing room.

20120921.text: Hmph, do you have any idea the hoops I had to jump through to get the Crystal Marrow and keep it hidden!? Ugh, fine! In that case, I'll send it over to you today.

20120922.text: And not even an ounce of shame for his actions...

20120923.text: So that's it!? My shop's been closed for weeks now — I've even had to ask my friends to help bail me out! What about my losses!?

20120924.text: Come on, Harrison! We've already struck a good deal here...

20120925.text: I'm sick of being pushed around like this! I won't let him off so easily!

20120927.text: Hey! What's all this racket? Does someone dare question the decree?

20120929.text: What was all the commotion I heard just now?

20120930.text: Oh, we were just discussing a minor tax issue. I do my utmost to lend them a helping hand, but they're never grateful.

20120931.text: A helping hand!? The only thing you're doing is stuffing your greedy pockets with our hard-earned wealth. I assure you that Hiiragi Shinsuke will hear of this!

20120932.text: Oh? And you dare to utter the Commissioner's name? You outlanders have no respect for the rules.

20120933.text: Seize the merchants! We will resolve this dispute back at headquarters!

20120934.text: Uh-oh, this is going in a bad direction...

20120935.text: Gentlemen, gentlemen. Come now, is there any need for this? If there's a dispute to resolve, let's get a drink and talk it over.

20120936.text: Who are you supposed to be? And why in my right mind would I join you for a drink?

20120937.text: Ha! You never heard of the fixer!?

20120941.text: Huh... you're from the Yashiro Commission?

20120943.text: Hmph, well, this is Kanjou Commission territory. However powerful the Yashiro Commission may be, you have no business meddling in Ritou's affairs.

20120944.text: Of course not. Of course not. Still, perhaps you could show the young lady of our clan some courtesy...

20120945.text: You wouldn't want your names showing up in a petition to the shogun, would you?

20120947.text: ...I don't need any trouble with her. Okay, let's forget all this. It'll give us one less thing to worry about.

20120950.text: Let's get dinner one day soon, gentlemen. My treat. I insist.

20120951.text: Eh, no response, huh... I suppose that bridge is well and truly burned, then.

20120952.text: Thank you so much, Thoma... But I'm sorry your relationship with the Kanjou Commission had to suffer for our sake...

20120953.text: #Haha. Hey, hey, I was joking. It's a small price to pay and you're more than welcome. If there's anyone you should be thanking, it's the Traveler. {F#She's}{M#He's} the one who found a way to turn things around.

20120954.text: If nothing else, I'm sure the tax-collection ashigaru will tread a little more carefully in future.

20120956.text: Shh... Not here, too many people listening, haha. Let's move somewhere else.

20121501.text: Corruption seems rife in the Kanjou Commission, they truly are rotten to the core... *sigh*

20121502.text: Alright. Time for me to answer your questions. What would you like to know?

20121505.text: Haha, straight to the point. Let me re-introduce myself.

20121506.text: I belong to the Kamisato Clan of the Yashiro Commission on Narukami Island. I'm an attendant of the Shirasagi Himegimi.

20121507.text: Ugh, you've been keeping your true identity a secret from us this whole time!

20121508.text: So, the Yashiro Commission. Guessing that's another branch of the Tri-Commission?

20121509.text: Correct. The Kamisato Clan is the head of the Yashiro Commission, who manage ceremonial and cultural affairs. I'd go into more detail on what exactly that covers, but I'm not even sure myself.

20121510.text: I'm just someone who was fortunate enough to be taken in by the Kamisato Clan. My role is to take care of the daughter of the clan — Kamisato Ayaka, also known as the Shirasagi Himegimi.

20121511.text: Seems like she must be super-famous in Inazuma, given the reaction of those guys just now.

20121512.text: Hahaha... Oh, most definitely. She's graceful, dignified, and kind-hearted, too. The people of Inazuma quite adore Miss Kamisato.

20121513.text: Her fame even somewhat eclipses that of her older brother, Kamisato Ayato, despite the fact that he is the current head of the clan.

20121514.text: I suppose those who treat others with compassion earn themselves the same treatment in return. Miss Kamisato's situation certainly seems to attest to that. Take me, for example — I'm just an attendant, and yet she treats me as an equal, as she would a friend.

20129101.text: Kurisu will reach his wits' end if things carry on like they are. Go see what you can do for him.

20129201.text: I can't thank you enough for helping me out. If you've got no place to go, you're always welcome at the International Trade Association.

20129301.text: Something tells me you've come up with a smart way to solve this...

20129401.text: Hmph. I'm the only lifeline they've got. How dare they try and bargain with me!

20129601.text: Thank you so much, our heads are back above water now...

20129901.text: Most of the current rules were put in place by the administration of Ritou — the Kanjou Commission.

20129903.text: Yes, one branch of the Tri-Commission of Inazuma. Responsible for growing and managing the nation's wealth. Um... you really haven't heard of it before?

20129904.text: Seems we got back just in time — Keijirou looks like he's about to collect more taxes. Quick, let's head over!

20129905.text: Now, who else is behind on payments?

20129906.text: Let me think... yes, the trade association clique still need to be brought into line.

20129908.text: Shh... Quiet! Don't let him find us!

20129909.text: Must be hearing things. Drat, I'm behind schedule. I need to hurry...

20129910.text: Come out. I can see you.

20129911.text: Who are you, and why are you following me?

20129912.text: Uh-oh, seems like he's noticed us...

20129915.text: He was right there a moment ago... Seems he disappeared in the blink of an eye.

20129916.text: If only we'd made less noise..

20129917.text: He's getting further and further away. Let's catch up a little.

20129919.text: Too close, that's too close! He'll notice us for sure!
